items.title: Open badges platform you can self-host
items.oneliner: Self-hosted credential platform issues Open Badges 3.0 and verifiable certificates with bulk CSV imports and recipient dashboards.

items.title: Practical TLSA setup guide for mail admins
items.oneliner: Step-by-step guide shows how to generate TLSA records, fix 3 1 1 mismatches, and verify DANE mail setup.

items.title: JavaScript physics engine for 3D simulations
items.oneliner: Open-source rigid body engine adds realistic 3D physics to JavaScript games and simulations with docs for framework integration.

items.title: Interactive chip fabrication walkthrough
items.oneliner: Rollercoaster Tycoon-style animation makes chip manufacturing stages clickable, visual, and easy to teach to engineers and students.

items.title: Recipe app build guide with Lovable
items.oneliner: Hands-on walkthrough shows how to build an AI-powered recipe app from prompt to working site without heavy setup.

items.title: Portable skills for AI assistants
items.oneliner: Open standard lets developers package assistant capabilities once and reuse them across compatible agent runtimes.

items.title: Open weather forecasting model with code
items.oneliner: Weather forecasting model ships with code and weights, giving researchers a runnable baseline for cyclone prediction experiments.

items.title: New benchmark for bioscience reasoning
items.oneliner: BioDecisionBench helps teams measure life-science reasoning failures instead of relying on generic LLM benchmarks.

items.title: Open runtime for coding agents
items.oneliner: Agent runtime stays open and offers persistent terminal workflows, plugin support, and a TUI for tracking active coding agents.

items.title: Self-printing program written as a GIF
items.oneliner: Piet quine includes code and generator for a GIF image that reproduces itself byte for byte.
